_meta.purpose: Runnable primitive: checkout's downstream to payment is completely unreachable (network partition analog). Adapted from OpenSRE's network-partition experiment. Signal is client-side conn_error outcome — the reason our earlier decisions to expose downstream_requests_total{outcome=...} exist.

title: [Triggered] checkout → payment downstream failure rate above 5%
message: Downstream calls from checkout to payment failing at >5%.
